Marbella's Feria San Bernabé is the biggest party on the Costa del Sol — and the best way to escape the crowds while still soaking up the atmosphere is from the deck of a private boat. Whether you want a sunset cruise, a day of swimming in quiet coves, or a floating base for fair-week celebrations, a Feria San Bernabé boat rental Marbella 2046 gives you flexibility, comfort, and views no beach bar can match. Our entire fleet departs from Puerto Banús, with skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks included from the moment you step aboard.

Why Rent a Boat for Feria San Bernabé?

Feria San Bernabé draws thousands to Marbella's streets and beaches. Renting a boat lets you enjoy the fair's energy on your terms — anchor near the fairground for a different perspective, or escape to quieter spots like Cala del Faro or Cabopino when the crowds get too much. With a private charter, you control the timetable, the music, and the company. No queues, no packed buses, no loud hotel pools.

What’s Included in Every Charter

No hidden fees, no surprise charges. Every booking includes:

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the full charter duration

Suggested Itineraries During Feria Week

Your skipper will tailor the route to your preferences, but here are three popular options for fair week:

  • Fair & Sunset (2–4 hours): Cruise past the Golden Mile, anchor near the fairground for a view of the lights, then head towards La Concha for sunset.
  • Cove Hopping (4–6 hours): Swim at Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, and Cabopino. Lunch at a chiringuito or onboard.
  • Coastal Explorer (6–8 hours): Head to Estepona or Sotogrande for a longer voyage with stops for swimming and lunch.

How to Book Your Feria San Bernabé Boat Rental

Bookings for Feria San Bernabé 2046 open now. To secure your preferred boat and time slot, message us on WhatsApp with your preferred boat, date, duration, and number of guests. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can also book directly online. Early booking is strongly recommended — fair week is one of the busiest periods on the Costa del Sol.

Cancellation Policy

We offer a straightforward cancellation policy:

  • 14+ days before departure: full refund
  • 7–13 days before departure: 50% refund
  • Less than 7 days: no refund

Weather-related cancellations are handled case by case. We recommend travel insurance to cover unexpected changes.
